test_type: Static structural and invariant tests. The Streamlit/Python runtime could not be launched from the current sandbox, so these tests validate file integration, route wiring, i18n coverage, report generation hooks, CSV structure, scoring invariants and user-flow guards.
key_assertions: The mode selector contains single-field, cooperative and pre-planting assessment modes.
Pre-assessment does not run automatically when the page loads; the user must click the run button.
Long operations have explicit Streamlit spinners.
Perennial crops are limited to one assessed production cycle in this mode.
Disease risks are bounded away from impossible certainty and impossible zero risk.
The disease pressure CSV has literature-prior columns and at least 28 disease rows.
The page and PDF expose suitability score, planting-date candidates, irrigation calendar, fertilization calendar and disease pressure priors.
The new visible labels are internationalized and the user guide was updated in Markdown and HTML.
